indicators.label: Religious affiliation
indicators.description: Share in the five printed affiliation lines: Islam, Christianity, Buddhism, Hinduism, and Others.
indicators.method: Sum the five printed affiliation lines and divide by the printed religion-line universe.
indicators.quality_notes: Source-printed category nulls remain null and are excluded only from the religion-line sum.

indicators.label: No Religion/Unknown
indicators.description: Share in DOSM's fused No Religion/Unknown role. The two Table 7 exceptions combine the separately printed No Religion and Unknown lines.
indicators.method: Use the fused historical line or sum the separately printed No Religion and Unknown Table 7 lines, then divide by the religion-line universe.
indicators.quality_notes: Every row discloses the frame-wide fused role; Table 7 rows also disclose the documented combine.
